intro: Technology and enterprise sectors were the primary targets in a recent wave of browser-security threats, with 13 articles published between 2026-04-11 and 2026-05-16. The threat actor Pushpaganda was observed, alongside critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-8573 and CVE-2026-8577, both with a CVSS score of 8.8, as well as CVE-2026-7896, CVE-2026-7897, and CVE-2026-7898. The coverage spanned global regions, with specific focus on Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom, and affected sectors also included email services. The severity mix comprised four high, four critical, three medium, and one informational alert.
